import ctypes
import math

def compute_inverse_hyperbolic_functions(x):
    # Load the required libraries in correct order
    cblas = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")
    
    # Set up function prototypes
    gsl.gsl_acosh.restype = ctypes.c_double
    gsl.gsl_acosh.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
    
    gsl.gsl_asinh.restype = ctypes.c_double
    gsl.gsl_asinh.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
    
    gsl.gsl_atanh.restype = ctypes.c_double
    gsl.gsl_atanh.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]
    
    # Call the GSL functions
    acosh_result = gsl.gsl_acosh(ctypes.c_double(x))
    asinh_result = gsl.gsl_asinh(ctypes.c_double(x))
    atanh_result = gsl.gsl_atanh(ctypes.c_double(x))
    
    return (acosh_result, asinh_result, atanh_result)

def assert_test():
    # Test case 1: Normal positive value
    result = compute_inverse_hyperbolic_functions(2.5)
    assert math.isclose(result[0], math.acosh(2.5), rel_tol=1e-10)
    assert math.isclose(result[1], math.asinh(2.5), rel_tol=1e-10)
    assert math.isnan(result[2])  # atanh(2.5) should be NaN since |x| > 1
    
    # Test case 2: Value exactly at 1 (edge case)
    result = compute_inverse_hyperbolic_functions(1.0)
    assert result[0] == 0.0
    assert math.isclose(result[1], math.asinh(1.0), rel_tol=1e-10)
    assert math.isinf(result[2]) and result[2] > 0  # Positive infinity
    
    # Test case 3: Value between 0 and 1
    result = compute_inverse_hyperbolic_functions(0.5)
    assert math.isnan(result[0])  # acosh(0.5) should be NaN
    assert math.isclose(result[1], math.asinh(0.5), rel_tol=1e-10)
    assert math.isclose(result[2], math.atanh(0.5), rel_tol=1e-10)
    
    # Test case 4: Negative value
    result = compute_inverse_hyperbolic_functions(-1.5)
    assert math.isnan(result[0])  # acosh(-1.5) should be NaN
    assert math.isclose(result[1], math.asinh(-1.5), rel_tol=1e-10)
    assert math.isnan(result[2])  # atanh(-1.5) should be NaN (|x| > 1)
    
    # Test case 5: Very large value
    result = compute_inverse_hyperbolic_functions(1e10)
    assert math.isclose(result[0], math.acosh(1e10), rel_tol=1e-10)
    assert math.isclose(result[1], math.asinh(1e10), rel_tol=1e-10)
    assert math.isnan(result[2])  # atanh(1e10) should be NaN
    
    # Test case 6: Very small positive value
    result = compute_inverse_hyperbolic_functions(1e-10)
    assert math.isnan(result[0])  # acosh(1e-10) should be NaN
    assert math.isclose(result[1], math.asinh(1e-10), rel_tol=1e-10)
    assert math.isclose(result[2], 1e-10, rel_tol=1e-10)  # atanh(1e-10) â 1e-10
    
    print("All tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
